name: ui-editor
description: UI 编辑器 — Roblox 工程工作台

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/build-electron.mjs
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && node tests/smoke.mjs && node tests/ui-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:welfare: node scripts/build-runtime-hosts.mjs && npm run build && tsx --test tests/welfare.test.ts && tsx tests/welfare-smoke.ts
scripts.test:styles: npm run build && tsx --test tests/template-styles.test.ts tests/projects.test.ts && tsx tests/project-template-style-smoke.ts && tsx tests/project-template-clone-smoke.ts
scripts.test:style-library: npm run build && tsx --test tests/style-preview.test.ts tests/template-styles.test.ts && node tests/style-library-smoke.mjs
